title: RAW whole-passage working reading: f25v as successive portion processing
summary: Exploratory IT2a seven-line draft, all57groups explicitly linked to tentative meanings or eight lexical holes. A single topic/material reference, reusable verb valencies and named results link the passage. No independent confirmation or reserve use; original1143story/glosses are not inherited as facts.
user_direction: Develop a coherent reading on admitted data before freezing and using reserved confirmation. Word meanings may be working hypotheses; prior profiles/counterexamples still constrain choices. This is development, not a retrospectively repaired fixed test.

lines.draft_german: Für [Zweck P0] bereite etwas davon fein auf einer Unterlage ohne Druck.
Nimm den äußeren oberen Teil davon und [Teil X1] davon ab; zerstoße etwas davon.
Unter [Bedingung C0] zerkleinere den unteren Teil davon; entnimm etwas davon; prüfe [Merkmal M1].
Anschließend koche den flüssigen Anteil davon; trenne den Rückstand davon ab.
Nun rühre; danach prüfe [Merkmal M2]; dann vereinige [Portion A davon] mit [Portion B davon].
Koche diese Zubereitung mit [Zusatz X2] bis [Zustand Z]; vereinige das Abgetrennte und den Auszug; und …
… schließlich lege die Mischung davon an [Ziel L].

lexical_status: All concrete German values are deliberate unconfirmed hypotheses. Profile compatibility is not support for the chosen gloss. Unknown bracketed contents remain unassigned. This is not a supported dictionary.

construction.topic: T is the current entry topic, hypothesized here to be a material. No plant species, animal or historical source identified. How the entry establishes T remains assumed.
construction.partitive: daiin has the same PARTITIVE(T) value everywhere. Following a part-noun it supplies its T complement; otherwise it supplies an unspecified portion argument. Two such arguments do not establish equal amounts, physical separation or their exact antecedent batches.
construction.material_patient: Unary processing predicates take an explicit next material NP when present; otherwise they use current result R. This is one general proposed ellipsis rule, not a line-specific gloss change.
construction.checking: dshey is CHECK(R,feature) with current R as patient and one explicit feature argument; M1 andM2 remain unknown.
construction.combining: cho is COMBINE(arg1,arg2). In line5 both arguments are bare PARTITIVE(T); in line6 they are named S andE. Result becomes R.
construction.named_results: Cooking stores/overwrites E and R; separation stores S and leaves a remaining R; combination replaces R. Therefore line6 combination uses S4 andE6, notE4.
construction.separable_predicate: ckhear NP chkear is one globally declared TRENNE-AB construction. chkear is not discarded.
construction.coordination: s coordinates like-typed material expressions or clauses, including across physical line boundaries. Drawing interruptions do not terminate the clause.
construction.scope_limit: Purpose/condition, adjunct attachment, all verb result semantics and the source of each implicit/partitive material argument are still proposed rather than fully specified for arbitrary unseen passages. No fully executable semantic parser is claimed.
